settings.text: Crafted in precious metals and laboratory-grown diamonds - conscious design for the modern woman and a better tomorrow.

settings.title: TISHVA
settings.subtitle: FOR THOSE WHO WEAR JEWELLERY AS THEIR SIGNATURE.

settings.text:
At Tishva, we don’t believe you have to follow old rules to wear something beautiful.

  • Laboratory grown diamonds look the same, last the same — just made in a smarter way.
  • No unnecessary mining. No outdated thinking. Just better choices.
  • Crafted in silver or gold, with certified diamonds available if you want them — no pressure, no presets.

Because modern women don’t compromise — they choose better.

settings.heading: Brilliance without Compromise
settings.intro_text: At Tishva, we believe luxury should be beautiful in every way - in how it looks, how it’s made, and how it makes you feel. That’s why we choose lab-grown diamonds.
settings.list_item_1: They offer the same brilliance, durability, and timeless appeal as mined diamonds, while being ethically created and environmentally responsible.
settings.list_item_2: By embracing lab-grown diamonds, we make fine jewellery more accessible, more conscious, and more aligned with the values of the modern woman.
settings.list_item_3: Every piece is crafted in hallmarked gold and set with IGI-certified diamonds, so you never have to choose between luxury and responsibility.

settings.text: Made with care and unconditionally loved by our customers, this signature bestseller exceeds all expectations.
